Some quests can't be found on any board. Live your life in this land and, one day, a messenger will walk up to you with a [ ! ] over their head and a task only you were meant to have.

What brought them is a secret: something you did, many times, or something about the kind of adventurer you are. Some messengers only come at night.

The messenger only comes when you are safe, out of combat. You can accept the task, ask them to come back later, or refuse it. Failing or logging out costs nothing: the messenger returns another time.

Each hidden quest is done only once, and its rewards are unlike any other.
